recognize_zh: 臨床照片中上排門牙的牙齦明顯腫大、暗紅發亮，部分覆蓋牙冠頸部，下排牙齦也發紅腫脹；在白血球升高且單核球比例高的急性白血病病人身上，這種牙齦增生提示單核球分化的 AML（如急性骨髓單核球白血病）浸潤牙齦。
features: Clinical photograph of the mouth with lips parted showing upper and lower anterior teeth
Swollen, dusky red to violaceous, glistening gingiva along the upper incisors extending over the cervical tooth margins
Similar erythematous swelling of the lower gingival margin
No histologic information; plaque/staining of teeth also visible
describe_en: Clinical photograph shows diffuse gingival enlargement involving the upper and lower anterior gingiva, with swollen, dusky red and glistening marginal gingiva and bulbous interdental papillae partly covering the cervical portions of the teeth. In a patient with leukocytosis, monocytosis and marrow blasts with monocytic differentiation, this appearance is consistent with leukemic infiltration of the gingiva, a classic extramedullary manifestation of acute myelomonocytic and monocytic leukemia. Biopsy is rarely required but would show infiltration by monocytic blasts.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced gingival overgrowth (phenytoin, cyclosporine, calcium-channel blockers)
ddx.vs: Drug-induced overgrowth is firm, pale pink and fibrous without bleeding and occurs with a relevant drug history and normal blood counts.
Scurvy causes spongy bleeding gums with perifollicular hemorrhages and corkscrew hairs but no circulating blasts or monocytosis.
Inflammatory gingivitis is localized to plaque-laden margins without massive diffuse enlargement or abnormal blood counts.

ddx.dx: Gingival involvement by other neoplasms (e.g., myeloid sarcoma, plasmablastic lymphoma)
ddx.vs: These form localized masses rather than diffuse symmetric enlargement and are distinguished by biopsy with immunohistochemistry.
